token.name: AI AD Coin
token.backing: 100% full fiat/USDC reserves in qualified custody

security_invariants.proof_of_reserves: Mint fails closed: a configured feed with a positive answer in 6 decimals, updated within MAX_RESERVE_AGE (1 day), must cover the new total supply
security_invariants.redemption_guarantee: Burn on withdrawal request; off-chain redemption is outside the contract
security_invariants.zero_leakage: Off-chain internal ledger postings mirror on-chain supply delta
security_invariants.access_control: Owner must be a multisig contract; two-step ownership transfer; minter and feed changes wait CHANGE_DELAY (2 days) and expire after CHANGE_GRACE (7 days); only the bridge minter mints; pause is immediate
security_invariants.activation: No testnet or mainnet deployment without operator approval; external audit before mainnet; legal opinion before any real-value use
